title: Nidec Financial Statements Summary for the Six Months Ended September 30, 2025
excerpt: Misstatements identified by ongoing investigations could have a material and pervasive impact on the interim financial statements.
summary: Nidec reported first-half fiscal 2025 net sales of JPY 1.302 trillion, operating profit of JPY 21.1 billion, operating cash flow of JPY 112.3 billion and free cash flow of JPY 45.2 billion. Automotive recorded an JPY 82.8 billion operating loss after contract-loss, impairment and supplier-claim charges. The report states that suspected inappropriate accounting could materially and pervasively affect the statements, that the impact was not reflected, that the report was not subject to interim review, and that full-year guidance was undetermined.
